items.english: If ν is greater than n, then always n(ν)=0; but if ν=n, then n(n)=1; and in general n(ν)=n(n−ν).
If ν is an odd number, q^{λ−ν} equals p^{λ−ν} + ½(1+λ(ν))p^λ + [0(ν−1)+0(λ−ν−1)]p + [2(ν−1)+2(λ−ν−1)]p^3 + … (general formula inferred by induction from the cases shown).
If ν is an even number, q^{λ−ν} has no p^{λ−ν} term and equals ½(1−λ(ν))p^λ − [0(ν−1)+0(λ−ν−1)]p − [2(ν−1)+2(λ−ν−1)]p^3 − … (general formula inferred by induction from the cases shown).
